Version Control

Commit Leluhur

A previous commit in the history of a branch or repository that forms the basis for subsequent changes, often used for merges and conflict resolution.

What is Commit Leluhur?

Definition

A previous commit in the history of a branch or repository that forms the basis for subsequent changes, often used for merges and conflict resolution.

Operational example

During a three-way merge, the ancestor commit provides a common baseline for resolving changes between branches.
